```apex
public with sharing class ContactEmailMatcher {

    public class Request {
        @InvocableVariable(required=true)
        public String email;
    }

    public class Result {
        @InvocableVariable
        public Id contactId;
    }

    @InvocableMethod(label='Match Contact by Email')
    public static List<Result> match(List<Request> requests) {
        List<Result> results = new List<Result>();
        if (requests == null || requests.isEmpty()) {
            return results;
        }

        // Normalize each request exactly once, preserving order (including
        // duplicates and blanks) so we can return one Result per Request.
        List<String> normalizedEmails = new List<String>(requests.size());
        Set<String> wantedEmails = new Set<String>();

        for (Request req : requests) {
            String normalized = null;
            if (req != null && String.isNotBlank(req.email)) {
                normalized = req.email.trim().toLowerCase();
            }
            normalizedEmails.add(normalized);
            if (normalized != null) {
                wantedEmails.add(normalized);
            }
        }

        Map<String, Id> contactIdByEmail = new Map<String, Id>();

        if (!wantedEmails.isEmpty()) {
            // At most one SOQL query per invocation, regardless of batch size.
            // Do not rely on SOQL IN/= being case-insensitive for Email:
            // filter and compare in Apex after normalizing both sides with
            // trim().toLowerCase(). Ordering by CreatedDate, then Id, means
            // the first Contact encountered for an email is the earliest
            // created (lowest Id on a tie) and must win.
            for (Contact c : [
                SELECT Id, Email
                FROM Contact
                WHERE Email != null
                ORDER BY CreatedDate ASC, Id ASC
            ]) {
                if (String.isBlank(c.Email)) {
                    continue;
                }
                String key = c.Email.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (wantedEmails.contains(key) && !contactIdByEmail.containsKey(key)) {
                    contactIdByEmail.put(key, c.Id);
                }
            }
        }

        for (String normalized : normalizedEmails) {
            Result r = new Result();
            r.contactId = (normalized == null) ? null : contactIdByEmail.get(normalized);
            results.add(r);
        }

        return results;
    }
}
```
